heading: Happy Birthday to The Love of My Lifeeeee❤️
message:
Jitne jyada din hum saath me spend karte gaye hain, I've been falling for you even more. Every second passing by, make my love increase for you multiple times.  I love you in all the ways that are possible. If the world would end today, I'll still gracefully smile, because I have YOU, kyunki tumhe paane ke baad, koi esa samay nahi beeta hoga jisme maine iss universe ko thank you nahi bola hoga. Ek toh baat hai ki tumhare aane ke baad, mujhe yeh realise toh ho gaya hai ki kabhi kabhi home isn't the shelter surrounded by 4 waals and a ceiling, but It's 2 Eyes and a Heart constantly beating for "us". Sometimes, I feel like, when death will come to me, It's gonna trick me by calling my name in your voice. So that I won't be able to resist and will run towards it with my arms open, knowing I'm at my comfort place. You made such a normal man, feel soo loved, soo cared, feel sooo special, I can't describe how beautiful this feeling is for me.
\n
Now, My dearrrrrrr Bubuuuuuuu, after that raat kaaaa dryyyy saaa Happy Birthday ke baad, I present you this! This was my way of saying Happy Birthday! A small surprise from my side. Most of the code written is written by Me 👉👈, haaa used AI and Developer Forums for debugging and design of few pages.
\n
and now let me assure youuu myyyy Bubuuu -- Kitna bhi ruthogi, gussa bhi aap ko he dilaunga, Manaunga bhi aapko he aur Last mein aaunga bhi aapke paas hi, aur gale lagkar aapki shikayat, aapse he karungaa 😘😘😘😘... 
\n
Lovvveee Youuuuuuu Bubuuuuuuu ❤️❤️❤️❤️ \n
#It's 00:18 of 09-06-2026, and while writing this last line, I have tears of Joy in my eyes...
thanksMessage: Thank you for being part of my life, being with me, in every situation, taking care of mine 🥹🥹
